title: Direct Preference Optimization with Unobserved Preference Heterogeneity: The Necessity of Ternary Preferences
reasoning: The paper evaluates its algorithms using the GlobalOpinionQA dataset, which specifically includes polling data on religion. Additionally, the core objective of the research is to develop alignment methods (EM-DPO and MMRA) based on fairness criteria to ensure equitable performance for diverse demographic groups, addressing ethical issues of bias and discrimination in LLM training.
